# Deployment mirror — do not edit directly

This `docs/` folder is a copy of `hebrew-practice-app/frontend/`, kept
here only because GitHub Pages can serve a branch's root or its `/docs`
folder, but not an arbitrary nested path.

**Edit the app at `hebrew-practice-app/frontend/`, then re-copy its
contents into `docs/` and commit** — this folder is not the source of
truth.
